name: Exchange agreement
what: The agreement with a qualified intermediary under which a like-kind exchange is carried out.

fields.label: Exchanging taxpayer
fields.definition: The taxpayer exchanging, exactly as it holds title to the relinquished property; compare it with the name that will take title to the replacement.

fields.label: Qualified intermediary
fields.definition: The intermediary that signs the agreement, any parent or affiliate that stands behind it, and any fidelity bond or insurance the agreement says it carries.

fields.label: Exchange type
fields.definition: Delayed, simultaneous, reverse or improvement, as the agreement sets it up.

fields.label: Agreement date
fields.definition: The date the agreement was signed; compare it with the relinquished property's closing date.

fields.label: Relinquished property
fields.definition: The property being sold, its buyer, and the sale contract assigned to the intermediary.

fields.label: Relinquished property transfer date
fields.definition: The date the relinquished property was transferred, from which both exchange periods run.

fields.label: Identification deadline
fields.definition: The last day to identify replacement property, as the agreement computes it.

fields.label: Exchange deadline
fields.definition: The last day to receive replacement property, as the agreement computes it, with a note if the tax return due date makes it earlier.

fields.label: Exchange proceeds
fields.definition: The net sale proceeds the intermediary received at the relinquished closing, matched to the seller's side of the settlement statement.

fields.label: Where the funds are held
fields.definition: How the intermediary holds the proceeds: a segregated, qualified escrow or trust account or a pooled account, who can move them, and who earns the interest.

fields.label: Limits on the taxpayer's access to funds
fields.definition: The clause limiting the taxpayer's right to receive, pledge or borrow against the proceeds before the exchange ends, and each stated event that releases them.

fields.label: Contracts assigned
fields.definition: Each sale or purchase contract assigned to the intermediary, with the date the other party was notified of the assignment.

fields.label: Who receives the identification
fields.definition: The party the agreement names to receive the signed identification of replacement property, and the delivery methods it accepts.

fields.label: Fees
fields.definition: The intermediary's fees, any interest it keeps, and added charges for a reverse or improvement exchange.
